experience.cue: A side grasp of a low object: centre less than about 4.5 cm above its support's top, lying deep enough that the forearm crosses the support's edge (about 0.17 m or more in on a straight approach). The entry times out short or the pre-grasp misses, and the hand ends up pitched nose-up with the jaw risen. Contacts posed from the trace put a wrist or forearm link on the slab's edge, not the fingers or the gripper housing.
experience.lesson: Put the forearm in the gripper's low outline, gated by whether it lies over the support. In pick.py, grasp_pitch and min_jaw must see pick.WRIST_LOW_POINT = (-0.15, -0.045) in the jaw frame (15 cm behind and 4.5 cm below the jaw centre; robot.xml's wrist yaw/pitch/roll and elbow links hang 2.9-3.5 cm below the jaw axis from 4 to 37 cm back, plus ~5 deg of attitude error) alongside GRIPPER_LOW_POINTS. Count it only when wrist_in = edge_depth_m + (-0.15)*cos(psi - face) >= WRIST_OVER_M = 0.02 m (pick.low_points). Its effect is to raise the level-grasp limit on the object's centre height from 3.4 to 4.5 cm. Such grasps then take the existing GRASP_PITCH_DEG 15 deg nose-down path: the wrist rises 3.4-3.9 cm with no jaw rise, since min_jaw(15 deg) stays 2.76 cm. Keep the gate. Shallow objects (0.09-0.16 m in) grasp fine level, while pitched ones carried ~0.65 m ahead slipped out of the jaw in 2 of 3. Do not un-pitch the wrist while holding (2 drops in 10). Check it worked: the wrist-on-slab contacts and the entry timeout disappear on deep starts, and level shallow starts produce the same rounds as before. PINCH_LOW_POINTS still omits the wrist; that case is untested.
experience.evidence: Isolated by candidates 50b15a38b026 (iteration 2) and 56bde6992e0a (iteration 3). Their into.py and parameter set are identical; only pick.py differs. Accept: 13 -> 14/60 against the same incumbent (b 4 -> 5, c 0 both). The single changed start was 50b's 'pregrasp missed by 8.3 cm', and that turned a rejection (p 0.0625) into an acceptance (p 0.031). Diag: adds apple s130051 (10 -> 11/50), 0 broken. The probe pair (iteration 2 H1 10/50 vs iteration 3 H1 11/50) shows the same +s130051. Scratch: 3 of 8 deep apples stalled level, and all 8 were grasped pitched. Gated vs 50b on 14 scratch starts: +3 / -1 (the -1 a safe set-down). The ungated version on the same code broke shallow s130001 (a drop) and s530008. Mechanism: posed contacts on 2 traces (s130009 attempt 1, s130051) show right_wrist_yaw on the slab edge, 10-22 deg nose-up.
experience.confidence: medium. The change is isolated by two candidates that differ only in pick.py, the sim is deterministic per start, it broke 0 of 110 pool starts, and posed contacts back the mechanism. But only 2 pool starts (1 diag, 1 accept) flipped. Every case is one object (the apple) on one table with the right hand. WRIST_OVER_M 0.02 and the 4.5 cm limit rest on 12 scratch starts.
